stories.title: Looking Ahead: Modeling Future Evolution in Autoregressive Video Generation
stories.summary: Autoregressive video diffusion models generate videos chunk by chunk, yet producing plausible continuations does not guarantee that they capture how scenes evolve. Under teacher forcing, strong temporal redundancy may allow local visual continuity to serve as a shortcut for current-chunk denoising, reducing the pressure to model visual evolution.

stories.title: Hallucination Detection Methods for AI Agent Workflows

Once that output triggers another workflow step, the mistake can quickly become a production problem.

stories.title: Software is slow because of bad design, not slow languages

Some languages are orders-of-magnitude faster than others: for instance, C can be fifty times faster than Python. Won’t rewriting my Python program in C thus make it fifty times faster?
